authentication.comparison: registration secret; exact value scheme must be confirmed, do not invent Bearer or HMAC

normalization_rules: Preserve original provider status and payload structure; internal statuses are separate.
Bind receiver registration to application connection, then bind resource/account to tenant from trusted records.
Keep credentials out of agent output, logs and durable business payloads; raw ingress capture must have restricted retention and access.
Compute local observedAt; provider event ID, ordering, replay API and complete modification timestamp are not established.
Do not assume receipt of a late event means it is the newest resource version. Preserve observations and reconcile eligible resources.
events.receiver_design: Proposed: authenticate, validate, durably enqueue, acknowledge 200, process asynchronously; confirm provider expectations before production.
